meta.title: State AI Policy Observatory
meta.coverage_note: Purposive 12-state sample. Counts reflect reviewed evidence, not total state activity or performance.

events.title: Cabinet approves Uttar Pradesh Artificial Intelligence Mission
events.date_basis: 10 October article says Cabinet approved it on Friday, which was 9 October 2026.
events.summary: Cabinet approved UP-AIM with an institutional structure, AI infrastructure and skilling plans, and proposed safeguards for high-impact government uses.
events.limitations: Cabinet approval verified from fetched reporting, not the underlying order. Startup, training and district-centre numbers are targets; proposed trust and assurance framework is not treated as an enacted regulatory instrument.

events.title: AI business allocation establishes departmental oversight role
events.date_basis: Policy note identifies G.O.(Ms).No.47, HRM(A), dated 5 August 2026; underlying order not independently fetched.
events.summary: Tamil Nadu's policy note attributes AI business allocation and departmental concurrence to G.O.47, within a government-wide AI assessment and rollout regime.
events.initiative: Tamil Nadu AI concurrence and oversight regime
events.limitations: Order date is reported by an official policy note; no independent legal-effect or implementation audit. The 2020 ethical policy itself predates the sample.
events.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu, AI, IT and Digital Services Department

events.title: Government issues Maharashtra AI Policy 2026 resolution
events.date_basis: Header of official Government Resolution POLICY-2026/C.R.64/IT states 06 May 2026; preferred to conflicting index metadata.
events.summary: The state issued the formal Government Resolution adopting its AI Policy 2026, with infrastructure, workforce, innovation and responsible-use provisions.
events.limitations: Official policy index lists 16/05/2026, but linked document header says 06 May 2026. PDF date retained; discrepancy disclosed. Formal adoption does not establish programme execution.
events.source_name: Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence Department, Government of Maharashtra

events.title: Cabinet approves Maharashtra AI Policy 2026
events.date_basis: Akashvani bulletin dated 30 April says cabinet action occurred yesterday.
events.summary: The cabinet approved a statewide AI policy proposing an AI Mission, compute and innovation infrastructure, skilling and startup support.
events.limitations: Investment and employment numbers in coverage are future targets. This cabinet milestone is distinct from the subsequent Government Resolution.
events.source_name: Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence Department, Government of Maharashtra

events.title: Responsible AI committee holds its first meeting
events.date_basis: Dated article explicitly says first meeting took place today.
events.summary: A committee chaired by Kris Gopalakrishnan began work on a safe, transparent and accountable AI framework for state governance.
events.limitations: Date is the first meeting, not the unknown constituting-order date; a completed or binding AI policy is not established by these sources.
events.source_name: Government of Karnataka, Department of Electronics, IT and BT

events.title: Gujarat establishes AI Implementation Cell
events.date_basis: Approved-date footer of DST circular reads 10 March 2026.
events.summary: Gujarat created an AI Implementation Cell under its science and technology department, headed by Gujarat Informatics Limited’s managing director, to coordinate the action plan.
events.limitations: Circular establishes institutional authority and composition; it does not provide staffing, execution or impact evidence.
events.source_name: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat

events.title: Gujarat approves AI Innovation Challenge funding and evaluation rules
events.date_basis: Official circular approved-date footer and electronic signature both date 13 February 2026.
events.summary: The state formalised challenge evaluation and funding rules, with indicative PoC ceilings of ₹7.5 lakh or ₹10 lakh and staged disbursement tied to deployment and departmental acceptance.
events.limitations: These are per-use-case indicative ceilings, not a total budget or disbursement. Annexure dated 19 July 2025 is not the circular approval date. Production support remains conditional.
events.source_name: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat

events.title: FY2026–27 budget proposes ₹225 crore for the AI Mission
events.date_basis: Budget document establishes amounts; fetched contemporaneous reporting expressly dates budget presentation to 11 February 2026.
events.summary: The state budget provided ₹225 crore for the AI Mission and separately ₹32.82 crore for AI labs and a centre of excellence.
events.limitations: Budget presentation/provision is not proof of appropriation passage, release or expenditure. Do not add the ₹2,000 crore mission announcement to these annual provisions; ₹2,059 crore is the whole IT/electronics sector, not AI.
events.source_name: Information & Public Relations Department, Uttar Pradesh

events.title: Telangana signs Blaize MoU for AI and semiconductor collaboration
events.date_basis: Official release dated 21 January 2026 describes the finalized MoU; updated 22 January.
events.summary: At Davos, Telangana signed an MoU with Blaize covering advanced AI capabilities, R&D expansion support and exploration of sectoral applications.
events.limitations: Potential healthcare, manufacturing and energy pilots were discussed, not reported as implemented. Existing Hyderabad R&D activity is not counted as a new state deployment.

events.title: Invest UP and AM Group sign proposed 1 GW AI-compute hub MoU
events.date_basis: Both government and company releases explicitly date the Davos signing 20 January 2026.
events.summary: Invest UP and AM Group signed an agreement for a proposed 1 GW AI-compute hub in Greater Noida.
events.initiative: AM Group Greater Noida AI compute hub
events.limitations: Official schedules conflict: Invest UP targets full capacity by 2028; AM Group says first capacity 2028 and full 1 GW by 2030. Planned ~$25 billion investment is a partner commitment, not state spending or completed capacity.
events.source_name: Invest UP, Government of Uttar Pradesh

events.title: Chief Minister announces Uttar Pradesh AI Mission
events.date_basis: Official release Posted On 12 January 2026 describes that day's announcement.
events.summary: The Chief Minister announced a state AI Mission at Lucknow's regional AI conference, with an approximately ₹2,000 crore programme described in the release.
events.limitations: ₹2,000 crore is the announcement's programme-scale figure, not evidence of annual appropriation or expenditure. Later annual budget provision and Cabinet approval are separate milestones.
events.source_name: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Electronics & IT

events.title: Minister announces Coimbatore AI Centre of Excellence under PPP model
events.date_basis: Article dates minister's announcement to Friday 17 October.
events.summary: Tamil Nadu's IT minister announced a planned AI Centre of Excellence in Coimbatore under a public–private partnership model.
events.limitations: Minister reported a recent government order; its date and text were not retrieved. Event date is public announcement, not approval.

events.title: UPDESCO and IndiaAI sign Data and AI Labs MoU
events.date_basis: Later parliamentary answer expressly dates execution to 26 September 2025; 24 July 2026 is the answer date.
events.summary: UPDESCO and IndiaAI signed an agreement to establish AI/data-skills labs in government ITIs.
events.limitations: PIB also reports an MoU ceremony on 12 January 2026 without identifying whether it renewed or expanded the September instrument; not counted as a second signing. Lab totals vary by date/scope (49, 62, 64); no operational census inferred.
events.source_name: Rajya Sabha / Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

events.title: AI Grand Challenge targets early identification of non-performing MSMEs
events.date_basis: 2026–27 official policy note retrospectively specifies September 2025, with no day.
events.summary: TNAIM, StartupTN and the MSME Department conducted a challenge to develop AI tools for early identification of non-performing MSMEs.
events.limitations: Month-level date only; a challenge is not a production deployment and successful models or interventions were not verified.
events.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu, AI, IT and Digital Services Department

events.title: Gujarat issues five-year AI implementation action plan
events.date_basis: March 2026 official circular identifies action-plan GR DST/DGT/e-file/24/2025/0581 as dated 24 July 2025.
events.summary: Gujarat adopted a six-pillar AI implementation roadmap for 2025–2030, spanning data, infrastructure, skills, research and use cases, startups, and safe and trusted AI.
events.limitations: 24 July is resolution date verified retrospectively; July 28 is news publication. Planned AI factories, training and mission are not treated as completed initiatives.
events.source_name: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat

events.title: AI-linked Agritech Innovation Hub opens at SVPUAT Meerut
events.date_basis: PIB release Posted On 8 July 2025 says inaugurated today.
events.summary: SVPUAT Meerut and IIT Ropar inaugurated an agritech hub linked to ANNAM.AI and signed an MoU for research and field deployment.
events.limitations: Included because SVPUAT is a state agricultural university and state ministers participated; central–state institutional collaboration, not a solely state-funded project. No farmer-impact measurement inferred.
events.source_name: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Education

events.title: TGDeX data and AI platform launches
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous report explicitly dates Wednesday's launch to 2 July; implementing partner confirms July 2025.
events.summary: The state launched TGDeX to provide datasets, AI models and development resources for public-sector innovation.
events.limitations: Dataset counts conflict: contemporary news says 500+ and an undated partner page says 1,000+ at launch. No harmonized inventory count or AI impact claim is inferred.

events.title: Cabinet approves MahaAgri-AI Policy 2025–2029
events.date_basis: Same-day cabinet approval bulletin dated 17 June 2025.
events.summary: MahaAgri-AI sets an agricultural AI roadmap spanning shared data infrastructure, innovation support and pilots, with an initial ₹500 crore allocation proposed in the policy.
events.limitations: The official policy calls ₹500 crore a proposed initial allocation; it is not a measure of spending. The policy’s planned platforms and centres are not counted as operational.

events.title: AI Pragya skilling initiative launches
events.date_basis: Article body explicitly gives Friday, 9 May 2025; article publication was 10 May.
events.summary: The Chief Minister launched AI Pragya in Lucknow to expand AI and digital skills, with a stated target of training one million young people.
events.limitations: Programme launch does not establish training completion, learner outcomes or World Bank financing specifically earmarked for AI Pragya.

events.title: BuildNow AI-assisted building approvals expand to HMDA
events.date_basis: Fetched 19 April article says extension occurred on Friday, 18 April; official platform archive also lists the expansion.
events.summary: Telangana extended its AI-assisted building-approval service from GHMC to the wider Hyderabad Metropolitan Development Authority region.
events.limitations: Operational means a publicly documented rollout, not an independent performance audit. Claims about seconds-long scrutiny must not be generalized to end-to-end legal approvals; later DTCP plans are not counted here.

events.title: Microsoft MoU proposes three AI centres for governance
events.date_basis: Hindustan Times report dated Wednesday 2 April says signing occurred Tuesday.
events.summary: Maharashtra signed an MoU with Microsoft for AI centres in Mumbai, Pune and Nagpur, covering geospatial analytics, forensic investigation and governance, plus staff training.
events.limitations: This records signing, not opening of all three centres. The agreement builds on existing MARVEL; do not count it as MARVEL’s first establishment.

events.title: Budget proposes AI courses and shared centres in government engineering colleges
events.date_basis: Date printed in the 2025–26 budget speech.
events.summary: Tamil Nadu proposed AI and other emerging-technology degrees plus shared centres of excellence in government engineering colleges at an estimated Rs 50 crore.
events.limitations: Rs 50 crore covers multiple technologies, not AI alone; future academic-year implementation not verified.
events.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu, Finance Department

events.title: Budget proposes AI-enabled Digital Agricultural Service Centres
events.date_basis: Budget paragraph 34; presentation date corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
events.summary: Proposed Digital Agricultural Service Centres would combine AI and geospatial tools to support farmers' crop decisions.
events.limitations: Specific rollout dates, coverage and operational outcomes were not verified.

events.title: Budget proposes AI/GIS attendance across government departments
events.date_basis: Budget paragraph 451; presentation date corroborated by contemporaneous reporting.
events.summary: Karnataka proposed an advanced attendance-management system using AI and GIS across all departments.
events.limitations: The budget uses future tense; no statewide deployment evidence verified.

events.title: Budget proposes Rs 50 crore over five years for CATS
events.date_basis: Budget presentation dated by contemporaneous report; proposal in budget paragraph 357.
events.summary: The 2025–26 budget proposed a Centre for Applied AI for Tech Solutions with Rs 50 crore investment over five years.
events.initiative: Centre for Applied AI for Tech Solutions
events.limitations: Budget proposal is not spending. A later undated official report describes Rs 20 crore for CATS; scopes are unresolved and amounts must not be added.

events.title: Microsoft and Telangana sign AI skilling and centre-of-excellence agreement
events.date_basis: Report published 14 February says the signing and event were Thursday, 13 February.
events.summary: A signed MoU covers AI training programmes and a proposed centre of excellence with cloud infrastructure and an AI knowledge hub.
events.limitations: Training 120,000 people and establishing the centre are announced commitments. The Microsoft office inauguration is not treated as opening the AI centre.

events.title: Telangana and Google sign cross-sector AI MoU
events.date_basis: Both fetched reports identify Thursday 13 February and the MoU exchange.
events.summary: The government and Google signed an MoU for AI applications in agriculture, mobility, education, sustainability and governance.
events.limitations: Both news reports appear to draw on the same announcement; they are duplicate coverage, not independent impact validation. MoU signing does not prove deployment.

events.title: Chief minister inaugurates GIFT City AI Centre of Excellence
events.date_basis: PTI contemporary inauguration report and February 2026 official circular both explicitly identify 27 January 2025.
events.summary: Gujarat inaugurated its GIFT City AI Centre of Excellence and launched an Innovation Challenge to connect government and industry use cases with innovators.
events.initiative: GIFT City AI Centre of Excellence
events.limitations: Inauguration advances the June 2024 MoU but does not establish sustained operation, completed pilots or impact; challenge launch is grouped within the same event.
events.source_name: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat

events.title: Uttar Pradesh signs Google Cloud agriculture-network MoU
events.date_basis: 8 January newspaper clipping explicitly says signing was Tuesday, 7 January; web article has a later update timestamp.
events.summary: The state signed an agreement for a Gemini-powered open agricultural network connecting farmers with advisory and other services.
events.limitations: Headline says launch, but body establishes an MoU; stage conservatively recorded as signed. Government-hosted newspaper clipping is the same reporting, not independent primary corroboration. Benefits are intended.

events.title: Gujarat constitutes ten-member AI taskforce
events.date_basis: 2026 DST circular identifies original taskforce GR as 10 December 2024; original document also records internal approval dated 9 December.
events.summary: Gujarat constituted a ten-member taskforce to guide its AI roadmap, sectoral use cases, capacity building, infrastructure and responsible deployment.
events.limitations: Original retrieved text omits top-level issue date; date is verified through later official circular. Internal file approval on 9 December is a different administrative step.
events.source_name: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat

events.title: Cabinet approves Bengaluru AI Centre of Excellence
events.date_basis: Article published 15 November explicitly says cabinet approved it on 14 November.
events.summary: Karnataka's cabinet approved a Bengaluru AI Centre of Excellence with a reported investment of Rs 28 crore.
events.limitations: Cabinet decision reported by news; underlying order not retrieved. Relationship to later CATS funding cannot be conclusively established.

events.title: Government approves AI mission and Rs 13.93 crore implementation sanction
events.date_basis: Date printed on G.O.(Ms).No.25.
events.summary: G.O.25 approved the TNAIM document and a Rs 13.93 crore administrative sanction for a two-year initial implementation phase.
events.limitations: Approval and administrative sanction are verified; disbursement, procurement and delivered outcomes are not.
events.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu, IT and Digital Services Department

events.title: Telangana unveils 2024–2027 AI strategy
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous article says Thursday at the summit's inaugural session; this is 5 September, not the article's 6 September IST publication date.
events.summary: The state released a six-pillar AI roadmap covering public services, local data, skills, compute access and an AI City.
events.limitations: Targets for 2027 are prospective. Strategy publication is not proof that individual programmes or an AI City were delivered; aggregator's 6 September launch date rejected.

events.title: Government exchanges AI ecosystem MoU with Google
events.date_basis: Official release dated 31 August states exchange took place today; retain official Indian reporting date.
events.summary: Tamil Nadu and Google exchanged an MoU covering planned AI labs, startup and MSME support, and workforce skilling.
events.limitations: MoU exchange occurred in California; local event date/time not independently resolved. Targets and proposed labs are not completed training or operating facilities.

events.title: Gujarat signs Microsoft MoU for GIFT City AI centre
events.date_basis: Same-day PTI report states Saturday signing; later inauguration report retrospectively identifies June 2024 agreement.
events.summary: Gujarat signed an MoU with Microsoft for an AI Centre of Excellence at GIFT City focused on machine learning, cognitive services and chatbots, alongside NASSCOM capacity collaboration.
events.initiative: GIFT City AI Centre of Excellence
events.limitations: Microsoft and NASSCOM signed separate commitments during one ceremony; capacity collaboration is retained in this ecosystem record rather than expanded into a third same-day row.
events.source_name: Hindustan Times / Press Trust of India

events.title: Gujarat and IBM sign MoU for GIFT City AI cluster
events.date_basis: Dated IBM release explicitly states today entered the MoU, corroborated by same-day PTI coverage.
events.summary: The state’s science and technology department signed with IBM to develop a watsonx-based AI cluster offering financial institutions sandbox, proof-of-concept and training support.
events.limitations: Signing is not proof that the cluster is operational. This IBM agreement is distinct from the Microsoft centre agreement signed the same day.

events.title: Cabinet approves MARVEL AI policing initiative
events.date_basis: March 17 contemporary report documents approval; NITI retrospective corroborates establishment in March. Exact approval day not explicit in retrieved prose.
events.summary: The cabinet approved an AI policing special-purpose vehicle with IIM Nagpur and Pinaka Technologies, with a reported ₹23 crore proposed investment.
events.limitations: ₹23 crore is reported proposed investment, not audited expenditure. Later official feature reports usage but its impact claims are not independently evaluated. MARVEL acronym expansions vary across sources.

events.title: Budget announces Tamil Nadu Artificial Intelligence Mission
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous budget report and later government order explicitly date announcement.
events.summary: The state budget announced an AI mission to develop guidelines and utilisation protocols across education, industry, research and other sectors.
events.limitations: This is the 2024 budget milestone; the later order also references an earlier 2023–24 assembly announcement outside this sample.
events.source_name: Government of Tamil Nadu, IT and Digital Services Department

events.title: Budget proposes AI software within prison-security equipment package
events.date_basis: Budget presentation date explicitly named in reporting.
events.summary: The budget proposed AI software alongside baggage scanners and other prison equipment in a combined Rs 5 crore package.
events.limitations: Rs 5 crore is the combined equipment package, not an AI-only allocation; procurement and use not verified.

events.title: Budget proposes an AI/ML administration unit
events.date_basis: Budget presentation date explicitly named in reporting.
events.summary: Karnataka's budget proposed an AI/ML unit to support technology-based administration and public-service delivery.
events.limitations: Announcement evidence only; no constituting order or launch date verified.

events.title: Forest Department launches AI surveillance to prevent elephant collisions
events.date_basis: ETV article dated Saturday 10 February says launched Friday; BBC independently confirms February launch.
events.summary: Tamil Nadu launched AI-enabled elephant detection near Madukkarai railway tracks, with cameras and alerts to forest and railway officials.
events.limitations: Launch and physical deployment verified by reporting; no independent causal evaluation of prevented deaths. ETV extraction returned only headline, deck and date.

events.title: Maharashtra signs cross-sector AI partnership with Google
events.date_basis: Contemporaneous 8 February report and embedded dated Deputy CM post in PTI coverage.
events.summary: The state signed an MoU with Google covering AI applications in agriculture, healthcare, education and public services, alongside skilling and innovation support.
events.limitations: MoU commitments are not evidence of launched applications or completed training; planned CoE is kept within this announcement.

events.title: Technical education department signs IBM SkillsBuild MoU
events.date_basis: IBM release dateline says January 12 and today signed; webpage publication metadata says January 11.
events.summary: Gujarat’s Commissionerate of Technical Education partnered with IBM to support AI, generative AI and other emerging-technology skills through SkillsBuild.
events.limitations: Release display date and dateline conflict by one day. Signing follows explicit dateline, with uncertainty retained. No Gujarat-specific completion count is established.

events.title: State approves Sarvam AI package for government departments
events.date_basis: Retrieved report establishes approval by publication on 7 August 2026; exact GR approval date was not retrieved.
events.summary: Maharashtra approved a reported ₹11.26 crore two-year Sarvam AI package, including Indus for about 2,500 government users and speech and outreach tools.
events.limitations: Approval date remains unknown; 7 August is publication, not occurrence. Counterparty confirms approved deployment but provides no measured active-user count. Outlay is not actual expenditure.

sources.title: AI-Powered Telangana: Strategy Document & Implementation Roadmap
sources.evidence_excerpt: over the next 3 years (2024-2027)
sources.evidence_summary: Primary strategy sets six pillars covering governance, datasets, skills, ecosystem and AI City; it contains commitments and targets, not achieved outcomes.

sources.evidence_excerpt: at the inaugural session of the two-day global Artificial Summit here on Thursday
sources.evidence_summary: Body places launch on Thursday, 5 September, despite publication just after midnight on 6 September IST; details planned AI nodal officers and services.

sources.title: Google, Telangana ink MoU to develop, deploy AI solutions for various sectors
sources.evidence_excerpt: Google and Telangana government on Thursday entered into a memorandum of understanding
sources.evidence_summary: Reports signed government partnership for AI across agriculture, mobility, education, sustainability and governance.

sources.title: Telangana collaborates with Google to accelerate AI-led transformation across sectors
sources.evidence_excerpt: The MoU exchange took place in the presence of CM A. Revanth Reddy
sources.evidence_summary: Same-event coverage, apparently based on the same announcement; corroborates occurrence but is not independent evidence of effectiveness.

sources.title: Microsoft to set up AI centre in Telangana
sources.evidence_excerpt: An MoU encompassing all the above initiatives was signed
sources.evidence_summary: CMO-attributed report describes 13 February signing for AI skilling, a proposed AI centre and cloud infrastructure; 120,000 trainees is a target.

sources.title: BuildNow Telangana: Building and Layout Approval System
sources.evidence_excerpt: 24/7 AI Powered Assistance
sources.evidence_summary: Live state service lists AI assistance, AI-RAG policy assistant and HMDA integration; its news archive includes the April 2025 HMDA expansion.

sources.title: Telangana expands AI-powered BuildNow approval system to entire HMDA region
sources.evidence_excerpt: on Friday extended its AI-powered ‘BuildNow’ online building approval system
sources.evidence_summary: Reports extension on Friday 18 April, already processed applications in GHMC, and future DTCP rollout; reported processing speeds are official claims.

sources.title: Telangana unveils first State-led digital public infrastructure for AI
sources.evidence_excerpt: was launched on Wednesday by IT and Industries Minister D. Sridhar Babu
sources.evidence_summary: Dates TGDeX launch 2 July 2025, states platform live, 500+ datasets and 20+ departments, identifies state department and partners.

sources.evidence_excerpt: Launched July 2025; live with 1000+ datasets
sources.evidence_summary: Implementing partner confirms platform and launch month, but describes 1,000+ datasets at launch versus contemporaneous report's 500+; no inventory count adopted.

sources.title: Blaize signs MoU with Telangana for electronics, semi-conductor, and AI initiatives
sources.evidence_excerpt: entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Blaize
sources.evidence_summary: State release dated 21 January, updated 22 January, describes Davos 2026 MoU, R&D support and exploration of AI use cases; not completed pilots.

sources.title: UP govt, Google Cloud launch AI-powered agri network
sources.evidence_excerpt: has signed an MoU with Google Cloud (India)
sources.evidence_summary: Describes Gemini-powered agricultural network and agreement; updated 8 January, underlying article first published 7 January per search metadata.

sources.publisher: Hindustan Times, clipping hosted by Invest UP
sources.title: UP, Google Cloud launch AI-powered agricultural network
sources.evidence_excerpt: on Tuesday signed an MoU
sources.evidence_summary: Government-hosted clipping remains secondary reporting, not a primary government statement. Tuesday preceding 8 January resolves signing to 7 January 2025.

sources.title: U.P. CM Yogi Adityanath unveils two initiatives with support of World Bank
sources.evidence_excerpt: on Friday (May 9, 2025)
sources.evidence_summary: Reports launch of AI Pragya on 9 May in Lucknow; training 10 lakh young people is an intended target, not training completed.

sources.publisher: Press Information Bureau, Ministry of Education

sources.evidence_excerpt: was inaugurated today at the College of Technology

sources.evidence_summary: Page 7 explicitly provides ₹225 crore for AI Mission and separate ₹32.82 crore for AI labs/CoE; proposed provisions do not establish spending.

sources.title: U.P. Government presents over ₹9.12 lakh crore budget
sources.evidence_excerpt: on Wednesday (February 11, 2026)
sources.evidence_summary: Body confirms budget presentation date; publication 11 February and update 12 February must not be confused.

sources.title: Digi push: Govt allocates Rs 225cr for UP AI Mission
sources.evidence_excerpt: allocated Rs 225 crore in the 2026-27 budget
sources.evidence_summary: Corroborates AI-specific annual budget amount and distinguishes it from ~₹2,000 crore longer-horizon programme.

sources.evidence_excerpt: on Friday approved the Uttar Pradesh Artificial Intelligence Mission (UP-AIM)
sources.evidence_summary: Article body dates Cabinet approval to Friday 9 October; describes intended independent society, seven pillars and proposed trust/assurance framework, not completed delivery.

sources.title: Karnataka Budget: State bets big on Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
sources.evidence_excerpt: The state government will soon establish an Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning administration unit.
sources.evidence_summary: Reports the 16 February budget announcement of an AI/ML administration unit and a Rs 5 crore combined prison-equipment package including AI software.

sources.title: Centre of Excellence in AI to come up in Bengaluru
sources.evidence_excerpt: the State Cabinet on Thursday (November 14) approved the establishment of a Center of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence
sources.evidence_summary: Reports cabinet approval on 14 November 2024 and Rs 28 crore investment for a Bengaluru AI CoE.

sources.evidence_excerpt: a Centre for Applied AI for Tech Solutions (CATS) will be established with an investment of Rs. 50 crore
sources.evidence_summary: Budget paragraphs 34, 357, 451 and 453(iii) respectively propose AI-enabled agricultural service centres, a five-year CATS investment, AI/GIS attendance, and describe an established AI Cell developing government-order tools.

sources.evidence_summary: Reports the responsible-AI committee's first meeting on 12 March 2026; Kris Gopalakrishnan chairs the group developing a policy and implementation roadmap, not an already enacted framework.

sources.title: Google and Tamil Nadu Government collaborate to build an AI-enabled ecosystem in the State
sources.evidence_excerpt: Google today exchanged a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Government of Tamil Nadu
sources.evidence_summary: Press release 1328 dates the MoU exchange to 31 August 2024 in its own reporting convention; covers planned AI labs, startup support, workforce skills and MSMEs.

sources.title: T.N. CM Stalin signs MoU with Google for AI labs, meets Apple and Microsoft officials
sources.evidence_excerpt: signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Google to set up AI laboratories in the State
sources.evidence_summary: Contemporaneous reporting corroborates the Google MoU. The article relies in part on state statements, so it is a second publisher rather than independent outcome verification.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu Forest Dept Launches AI-Enabled System To Prevent Elephant Deaths
sources.evidence_excerpt: on Friday launched its ambitious Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning-enabled surveillance
sources.evidence_summary: Fetched headline, deck and publication date establish the launch on Friday 9 February 2024. Full body was not returned by Tavily; deployment corroborated by BBC.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu: These elephants are dying on rail tracks - can AI save them?
sources.evidence_excerpt: The project, launched in February, has been executed at a cost of 72.4m rupees
sources.evidence_summary: Fetched body describes 12 AI-camera towers at Madukkarai and alerts to forest and railway officials. Publication date was not exposed in the extracted body; unrelated current navigation dates ignored.

sources.publisher: Government of Tamil Nadu, Finance Department
sources.title: Budget Speech 2025–26
sources.evidence_excerpt: new degree courses in emerging fields such as Artificial Intelligence
sources.evidence_summary: Budget paragraph 73 proposes AI and other emerging-technology degrees in government engineering colleges and Rs 50 crore in shared centres of excellence; the total is not AI-only funding.

sources.publisher: Government of Tamil Nadu, AI, IT and Digital Services Department
sources.title: Demand No. 31: Policy Note 2026–2027
sources.evidence_excerpt: In September 2025, TNAIM conducted a Grand Challenge
sources.evidence_summary: Pages 101 and 103–115 retrospectively date an MSME AI challenge and describe AI oversight under G.O.47 dated 5 August 2026, including departmental concurrence and TAM-DEF/DEEP-MAX assessment. Publication day is not given.

sources.title: Tamil Nadu government to set up AI Centre of Excellence in Coimbatore under PPP model
sources.evidence_excerpt: will set up a Centre of Excellence in Coimbatore for Artificial Intelligence under public private partnership model
sources.evidence_summary: Minister's announcement on 17 October 2025 reports a recent government order but does not identify its date; same event also launches a CII–ICT Academy AI Institute.

sources.title: TN Pushes AI, Digital Governance And High-Speed Connectivity
sources.evidence_excerpt: Citizens affected by AI-assisted government decisions will have the right to know that AI was used
sources.evidence_summary: Dated reporting corroborates the 2026–27 policy note's AI safeguards and mission expansion. It is coverage of the same policy note, not evidence that rights have been exercised or enforced.

sources.title: Google partners with Maharashtra govt to provide AI-led services
sources.evidence_excerpt: Tech giant Google on Thursday signed a Memorandum of Understanding
sources.evidence_summary: Contemporaneous authored report says Google and Maharashtra signed Thursday; outlines agriculture, healthcare, skilling, sustainability and startup commitments. Describes proposed AI CoE and 500 officials to be trained; these are commitments, not verified completions.

sources.title: Maharashtra Signs Pact With Google For Harnessing Artificial Intelligence
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Maharashtra government on Thursday signed a Memorandum of Understanding
sources.evidence_summary: PTI report independently covers signing in Pune and embeds Deputy CM post explicitly dated 8 February 2024. Syndicated PTI attribution retained.

sources.title: Cabinet okays AI use by cops, ₹23cr for MARVEL project
sources.evidence_excerpt: govt will invest Rs 23 crore in the project
sources.evidence_summary: Reports cabinet approval of an AI policing SPV with IIM Nagpur and Pinaka Technologies and ₹23 crore proposed investment. Article describes timing relative to election code; exact event day not explicit in prose.

sources.title: MARVEL Brings AI-Powered Crime Prediction to Maharashtra’s Law Enforcement
sources.evidence_excerpt: Established in March 2024
sources.evidence_summary: Retrospective government feature says MARVEL was established March 2024 and by its July 2025 update served multiple departments. Promotional impact figures lack independent evaluation, so they are not used as outcome measures.

sources.title: Maha government signs MoU with Microsoft to speed up AI integration in administration
sources.evidence_excerpt: signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Tuesday
sources.evidence_summary: Authored report says MoU signed Tuesday, resolving to 1 April 2025; three planned centres address geospatial analytics, forensic work and MARVEL; employee training through MS Learn. Describes separate broadening of MARVEL but no completion evidence.

sources.title: Maharashtra Govt partners with Microsoft to stablish 3 AI centres of excellence
sources.evidence_excerpt: three cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence (AI) centres of excellence
sources.evidence_summary: Public broadcaster confirms signed MoU and planned centres in Mumbai, Pune and Nagpur; supports scope but does not itself supply exact signing date.

sources.title: Maharashtra: Cabinet approves MahaAgri-AI 2025-29 to transform agri sector
sources.evidence_excerpt: The Maharashtra Cabinet has approved MahaAgri-AI 2025-29
sources.evidence_summary: Contemporaneous 17 June cabinet report confirms approval of MahaAgri-AI 2025-29 and AI, generative AI and related agricultural technologies.

sources.title: MahaAgri-AI Policy 2025–2029
sources.evidence_excerpt: An initial allocation of ₹500 crore is proposed
sources.evidence_summary: Official policy sets institutional governance, shared agricultural data infrastructure, pilots and scaling; executive summary states an initial ₹500 crore allocation is proposed. Not evidence of expenditure or completed systems.

sources.title: Maharashtra announces AI Policy 2026 to boost industry, governance and public services
sources.evidence_excerpt: at a meeting chaired by Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis yesterday
sources.evidence_summary: Article dated 30 April 2026 says cabinet declared policy yesterday, establishing 29 April event date. Policy goals include investment, jobs, skilling and a venture fund; all are targets.

sources.publisher: Electronics, Information Technology and Artificial Intelligence Department, Government of Maharashtra
sources.title: Maharashtra Artificial Intelligence Policy 2026, GR POLICY-2026/C.R.64/IT
sources.evidence_summary: Official Marathi PDF header dates Government Resolution 06 May 2026. It adopts statewide AI policy including infrastructure, skills, startup support and responsible use. Document date takes precedence over inconsistent index metadata.
sources.date_conflict: Official policies index labels this item 16/05/2026; PDF header reads 06 May 2026.

sources.title: Policies & Guidelines
sources.evidence_excerpt: Maharashtra AI Policy-2026
sources.evidence_summary: Official listing links the AI Policy PDF but assigns 16/05/2026, conflicting with PDF header 06 May 2026. Used to preserve discrepancy and provenance, not as the event date.

sources.title: Maharashtra clears ₹11.26 cr Sarvam AI deployment for govt departments
sources.evidence_excerpt: a two-year outlay of ₹11.26 crore
sources.evidence_summary: PTI reporting of Government Resolution approval describes ₹11.26 crore two-year package, Indus for roughly 2,500 users, other speech/voice services and a TB outreach pilot. Exact GR approval date is not shown; approved deployment is not verified rollout.

sources.title: Sarvam partners with the Government of Maharashtra to deploy Indus across state departments
sources.evidence_excerpt: Around 2,500 officials across the state will use Indus
sources.evidence_summary: Counterparty confirms state has approved Indus deployment for around 2,500 officials and multilingual document work. Undated marketing page uses future-tense adoption; cannot establish adoption counts or service effectiveness.

sources.title: IBM collaborates with CTE Gujarat to propel skilling in AI and emerging technologies
sources.evidence_excerpt: India, Bengaluru, January 12, 2024
sources.evidence_summary: Page displays Jan 11 but release dateline explicitly says January 12, 2024 and today entered into MoU. Partnership uses SkillsBuild for generative AI, cloud and technical education. Global IBM targets are not Gujarat delivery numbers.
sources.date_conflict: Displayed publication Jan 11; release dateline and URL Jan 12; signing uses dateline with explicit caveat.

sources.title: IBM and Government of Gujarat sign MoU to establish AI Cluster in GIFT City
sources.evidence_excerpt: today entered a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)
sources.evidence_summary: Dated partner release confirms signing with DST for a watsonx-based AI cluster serving financial institutions; sandbox, proof-of-concept support and training are planned.

sources.publisher: Hindustan Times / Press Trust of India
sources.title: Gujarat government signs MoUs with IBM, Microsoft, and NASSCOM for AI development
sources.evidence_excerpt: Microsoft and the Department of Science and Technology signed an MoU
sources.evidence_summary: Reports Saturday signing of distinct MoUs with IBM, Microsoft and NASSCOM. IBM cluster and Microsoft CoE are different commitments and not duplicates; NASSCOM capability support recorded within CoE ecosystem rather than split into another row.

sources.publisher: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
sources.title: Setting up of AI Taskforce; GR DST/DGT/e-file/24/2024/1406/E-Governance
sources.evidence_excerpt: resolved to constitute AI Taskforce
sources.evidence_summary: Original resolution constitutes ten-member taskforce with AI roadmap, use case prioritization, ethics, infrastructure and capacity responsibilities for one year. Internal file approval is dated 9 December; subsequent official circular identifies resolution date as 10 December 2024.

sources.publisher: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
sources.title: Establishment of AI Implementation Cell; circular DST/AIE/e-file/24/2026/0291/E-Governance
sources.evidence_excerpt: Approved Date: 10-03-2026
sources.evidence_summary: Approved-date footer 10 March 2026; establishes AI Implementation Cell headed by GIL MD. Read clauses identify taskforce resolution 10 December 2024, extension 31 December 2025, and action-plan resolution 24 July 2025. Strong official retrospective date evidence.

sources.publisher: Rediff Money / Press Trust of India
sources.title: Gujarat AI Centre of Excellence Launched at GIFT City - Microsoft Partnership
sources.evidence_excerpt: Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel inaugurated an Artificial Intelligence Centre of Excellence
sources.evidence_summary: PTI Ahmedabad dateline January 27 reports CM inauguration and Innovation Challenge launch. Explicitly links the centre to June 2024 Microsoft MoU; inauguration does not demonstrate scaled public-service impact.

sources.publisher: Department of Science and Technology, Government of Gujarat
sources.title: Launch and operational modalities of AI Innovation Challenge; circular DST/AIE/e-file/24/2025/1433/E-Governance
sources.evidence_excerpt: Approved Date: 13-02-2026
sources.evidence_summary: 13 February 2026 approved-date footer and e-sign. Retrospectively confirms CoE launch 27 January 2025. Sets KPIs, PoC evaluation, indicative funding up to ₹7.5/10 lakh and production support up to ₹50 lakh/₹1 crore; disbursement and acceptance rules. Annexure internally dated July 19 2025, distinct from circular approval.

sources.title: Gujarat approves action plan for Artificial Intelligence implementation in governance
sources.evidence_excerpt: Published - July 28, 2025 03:10 am IST
sources.evidence_summary: Reports six-pillar 2025–2030 action plan, training target of 2.5 lakh and phased implementation. Local published date July 28 03:10 IST differs from index UTC July 27; neither is the official July 24 resolution date.

notes: Research window: 2024-01-01 through 2026-11-10 inclusive. Six Telangana and eight Uttar Pradesh distinct milestones, not a comprehensive census.
Event dates are normalized separately from article publication dates. Primary documents and article-body dates outrank upload paths, search metadata and current template banners.
Primary government statements and corporate statements establish reported commitments, not effectiveness. Confidence grades concern factual occurrence and attribution only.

Duplicates: Google Telangana two outlets collapse into one MoU; Uttar Pradesh Google web story and Invest UP clipping are the same original publisher; TGDeX partner and news describe one launch; AM Group and Invest UP describe one signing.

Same-initiative milestones retained separately: UP AI Mission January announcement, February annual budget provision, October Cabinet approval. Counts must not be interpreted as number of independent programmes.

Retrieval performed with Tavily and Exa; Firecrawl attempt failed for zero credits. Tavily returned 429 on a later extraction batch; fallback Exa succeeded on relevant Telangana sources. Full retrieved pages were read; only short evidence excerpts and paraphrases are retained.
Search coverage is English-led with a bilingual Telangana official release. Missing activity is not absence of policy, and no outcome league table is justified.
Important unresolved conflicts: AM Group compute hub 2028 vs 2030 full-capacity target; TGDeX launch inventory 500+ vs 1000+; UP labs MoU execution versus later ceremony. Retained explicitly.
Six Telangana records include no standalone AI-specific budget figure: ₹774 crore in state IT budget is sector-wide, not valid as AI allocation.
Firecrawl returned: For more credits, you can upgrade your plan at https://firecrawl.dev/pricing or try changing the request limit to a lower value.
Selected two southern states with contrasting institutional evidence, not a representative sample or rank of government performance.

All 16 retained source URLs were fetched with Tavily extract. Firecrawl fallback for ETV failed with insufficient credits; Tavily's partial ETV response plus full BBC body suffice only for launch and deployment claims.

Retrieval date is 2026-11-10; article publication dates are taken from article bodies or date-bearing search metadata, never current navigation/footer clocks. The 2026 Karnataka committee article explicitly dates its first meeting; the TN official policy note explicitly cites a 2026 government order.

Deduplication examples: S-TN-03 and S-TN-04 describe the same Google MoU; S-KA-03 and S-KA-04 describe the same CATS budget proposal. News coverage of government documents is not independent confirmation of outcomes.
Mission announcement and approval are distinct milestones of one initiative. They must remain linked and must not be interpreted as two AI missions.

Karnataka CoE names and financing scopes are not sufficiently resolved to merge the Rs 28 crore cabinet approval, Rs 50 crore five-year CATS proposal and later Rs 20 crore CATS description into one summed investment figure.
Amounts embedded in narrative are qualified: combined prison equipment and multidisciplinary education centres are not AI-only spending, and sanctioned or proposed budgets are not actual expenditure.
Month-only September 2025 event uses partial ISO 2025-09. Null publication dates remain null for undated PDFs; event dates come from dated passages, not file paths.
English-language and searchable official-PDF bias remains. No claim of exhaustive activity through cutoff; 2026 reports may retrospectively describe prior events.
Underlying G.O.47 dated 5 August 2026 was not fetched; the event is grounded in its explicit description in the official 2026–27 policy note and corroborative reporting, with medium confidence.

Seven Maharashtra and eight Gujarat events. Selected for traceable government action, not news volume. All substantive inclusion sources were retrieved, with concise evidence summaries rather than copyrighted full-text redistribution.
Raw search strings may contain a hypothesis date; final records use retrieved evidence. Search hints were not silently promoted to facts.

Each row is a distinct governmental milestone. Maharashtra AI policy cabinet approval and subsequent resolution share an initiative but remain distinct milestones; Gujarat CoE signing and inauguration likewise.

IBM and Microsoft agreements signed at the same Gujarat ceremony are distinct counterpart commitments. News articles repeated across publishers are attached to their event instead of duplicated as rows.
Public broadcasters and IndiaAI-style reports are treated as news, not the state issuing authority. Partner releases establish first-party claims, not independent outcome evaluations.
Dates use local displayed India time where available. The Hindu 28 July 03:10 IST is 27 July UTC, explaining a search index discrepancy.
Maharashtra policy date conflict: official index 16 May 2026 versus PDF header 06 May 2026. Document date wins but confidence reduced.
IBM CTE date conflict: publication display 11 January 2024 versus release dateline 12 January. Explicit dateline retained with medium confidence.
Sarvam approval date is unknown; publication date 7 August 2026 is not substituted. MARVEL establishment month is preserved as 2024-03, not invented as the first of the month.
Gujarat's 2026 implementation-cell circular gives traceable references for original action plan and taskforce dates. Direct original taskforce document also inspected.
No independent impact or benefit claims are asserted. Budget targets, proposed allocations, commitment ceilings and contract outlays are never aggregated into total spending.

Tavily briefly returned 429; connector Tavily required reauthentication, while direct Tavily worked. Exa retrieval provided fallback. Firecrawl failed due to zero available credits; no Firecrawl evidence was fabricated.
Firecrawl tool requested disclosure: For more credits, you can upgrade your plan at https://firecrawl.dev/pricing or try changing the request limit to a lower value.

Coverage is a purposeful verified sample, not an exhaustive census. Recent-event searches included 2026; latest included western-state announcement is reported August 2026. Absence of later rows is not absence of later activity.
